title: Gotrade Daily: Bank Earnings and a Chip Slump Close the Week
summary: Truist, M&T, Regions, Citizens and Travelers report before the US open, while chip stocks try to end a seven-session slide.
body_markdown:
### Chip stocks and AI spending doubts


**Nvidia ([NVDA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) )** fell 1.84% on Thursday. Investors are questioning debt-financed AI infrastructure spending, with CoreWeave and Oracle under scrutiny,[according to Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-edge-lower-as-ai-spending-fed-rate-concerns-weigh-4952930) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of 1:53 a.m. EDT, Nasdaq 100 futures were up 0.10%, S&P 500 futures up 0.13% and Dow futures up 0.14%,[according to TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/u-s-stock-futures-rise-as-tech-selloff-eases) . **Tesla ([TSLA](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tsla/) )** is in focus after it[showed off its long-delayed next-generation Roadster](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/tesla-roadster-reveal-what-to-know-about-the-delayed-ev.html) .


## Macro Note 📝


US wholesale prices rose 1.3% in September and 6.3% from a year earlier,[according to TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/u-s-stock-futures-rise-as-tech-selloff-eases) . CME FedWatch priced a 67% chance of a Fed rate increase by December, and the 10-year Treasury yield sat near 5.09%,[according to Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/nasdaq-futures-edge-lower-as-ai-spending-fed-rate-concerns-weigh-4952930) .


## Conclusion


Tonight's bank reports will show how well lending and deposits are holding up with rates this high. Chip stocks will decide whether the Nasdaq closes the week on calmer footing.


Bank guidance for the coming quarters has usually moved shares more than the quarter itself. Treasury yields are worth watching through the session too.
